items.description: Electrician labour checking and rewiring the flooded basement circuits
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.6.1/3.6.2: The cause was inundation (surface water/rainwater from outside), not an insured peril (escape of water), and the schedule does not record natural hazards (flood/inundation) as insured. All work on affected installations is barred.
Excluded by 3.6.2 and 7.1.8(b): Ancillary/site charges are not indemnified when the claim is barred for cause. Even if covered, only one journey charge per event is allowed (7.1.7(g)).

Excluded by 3.6.2 and 7.1.8(b): Working equipment and its procurement are not indemnified when the claim is barred for cause. Even if covered, working equipment is not separately indemnified (5.2.2, 5.2.3).
Excluded by 3.6.2 and 7.1.8(b): Working equipment for water removal is not indemnified when the claim is barred for cause. Even if covered, not indemnified separately (5.2.2).

items.description: Water extraction from the flooded basement
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.6.2: Measures to remove standing water are not indemnified when the cause is inundation and the peril group is not insured. Even if covered, would be a measure (5.2.2) but is barred here.

items.description: Small electrical materials for the rewiring
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.6.2: Materials for repair of affected installations are not indemnified when the claim is barred for cause (inundation, not insured).

items.description: Renew boiler system including flue gas system and storage tank
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.6.2: Replacement of plant of the building is not indemnified when the cause is inundation and the peril group is not insured. All work on affected installations is barred.

items.description: Adjust supply pipework to fit the replacement boiler
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.6.2: Ancillary work to adapt pipework for replacement plant is not indemnified when the claim is barred for cause (inundation, not insured).

items.description: Dispose of the old boiler system
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.6.2: Debris removal and disposal of affected plant is not indemnified when the claim is barred for cause (inundation, not insured).
Excluded by 3.6.2 and 7.1.8(b): Ancillary/site charges are not indemnified when the claim is barred for cause. Even if covered, only one journey charge per event is allowed (7.1.7(g)).
